style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. 1950s-1960s Italian period details. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty white space with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, badges or emblems of real companies (no bull emblem, no prancing horse emblem), car brand names, readable text or numbers, license plates with characters, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people
